text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: When I went to the cafeteria at mealtime, I found Mejiro Ardan surrounded by an unfamiliar spread of dishes.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, hello.
Look at this, isn't it an unusual dish?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: This is medicinal cuisine. It's a meal designed to support the function of your internal organs.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
"Apparently, they introduced it here on a trial basis,
but because of its unique flavor, nobody really orders it."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: It pains me to see food go to waste, and since I am accustomed to dishes like these, I took the liberty of ordering a bit extra.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
I might have gone a bit overboard with my order,
but I intend to take in plenty of nutrients.
choice_data_list: That's going to be an overdose.
Eat up plenty and build up your strength.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
...Is this portion perhaps a bit too large after all?
However, leaving any behind is out of the question...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
...Thank you very much.
I shall gladly take you up on your offer.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
Well then, I'll calculate the nutritional value
to see what the appropriate portion is, so please wait a moment.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Afterward, I helped eat the portion that Mejiro Ardan realized she had over-ordered.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
Yes. I will build a body capable of winning races,
so please look forward to it.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Afterward, Mejiro Ardan finished all of her
medicinal cuisine, taking in plenty of nourishment.
